text:
Cass: Found a tiny Post-it with sunglasses stuck to the whiteboard corner labeled "Paddington - Office Mascot". Who's the new mascot whisperer? :sunglasses:
Rafi: That was me. Paddington is our silent overlord. He approves whiteboard scribbles and steals meeting minutes (metaphorically). :post-it:
June: Paddington already has lore: appears only when snacks are present, disappears during code reviews. This is perfect.
Mo: Can we make an official initiation? I propose a tiny oath: "I pledge to feed Paddington stickers, not lies." Short and binding. React :thumbsup: if you support.
Cass: I support. Also suggestion: a tiny sweater for Paddington. I knit a scarf. Risky but charming.
Rafi: Poll idea: name him Paddington, Pad, Sticky, or Captain Corner. React :one: :two: :three: :four: to vote.
June: Also we should have a mascot steward who ensures Post-it supply, performs seasonal hat swaps, and will take blame for accidental doodles. Volunteer?
Mo: I'll volunteer as steward if I get to pick the first hat (tiny paper fedora). Deal? :top_hat:
PingBot: Poll created: "Name the Post-it Mascot". Options: 1) Paddington, 2) Pad, 3) Sticky, 4) Captain Corner. Channel: #random.
Cass: Tiny tradition proposal: on the last Friday of the month, bring a novelty Post-it to add to Paddington's wardrobe. Winner gets a small sticker. Low-effort, high-culture.
Rafi: Also idea: if you borrow a marker and don't return it within 24 hours, you must leave a tribute Post-it. Enforcement via passive-aggressive notes.
June: Steward duties sound fun. I'll be co-steward and run the wardrobe rota. Mo you get the fedora. I'm taking responsibility for seasonal sweater rotations.
Mo: Accepted. First duty: photograph Paddington in his scarf and add to #random-lore album. Also schedule a monthly reminder: "Paddington Wardrobe Check".
PingBot: Reminder scheduled: "Paddington Wardrobe Check" monthly on the 1st at 09:00am. Channel: #random.
Cass: Vote so far: Paddington (6), Pad (2), Sticky (1), Captain Corner (0). Paddington is winning by a landslide. He is very British.
Rafi: For the record, Paddington's hobbies include: silently judging seating choices and photobombing retros.
June: We'll draft a tiny proclamation: "By decree of #random, the Post-it in the west corner is hereby named Paddington, Office Mascot. Wardrobe and tributes to be maintained by the Paddington Steward(s). Offenders shall be gently shamed." Thoughts?
Mo: Love it. Also we should make tiny merch: a 1" sticker. I will design it if someone funds the sticker printing kitty.
Cass: I'll start a small Google Sheet for wardrobe rota and tributes. Columns: date, contributor, item, emoji. Low effort, maximum joy.
PingBot: Poll closed. Winner: Paddington. Congratulations: Paddington is official.
Rafi: Paddington ascends. Ceremony: five-minute reveal tomorrow at 3pm at the whiteboard. Bring tiny Post-its for tributes. Photo ops encouraged.
June: Ceremony confirmed. Short, silly, sweet. I will read the proclamation in a solemn whisper.
Mo: I'll bring the fedora. Might craft a tiny cape if I'm feeling theatrical.
Cass: Closing: long live Paddington. This office is slowly becoming a museum of tiny decisions and excellent taste. Also paddington-themed stickers upcoming. :heart:
